source.stem: A store sold a sack of rice for ₱250. It raised the price by 20%. A week later, it cut the new price by 20%. What is the final price of the sack?

reveal.terms: "Percent" means "out of 100". 20% of a price is 20 pesos for every 100 pesos. "Raise by 20%" means add 20% of the price at that moment. "Cut by 20%" means take away 20% of the price at that moment.
reveal.shortcut: Each change uses the price right before it. Tiny example: ₱100 up 10% is ₱110. Then down 10% is ₱110 − ₱11 = ₱99, not ₱100. Now this item: ₱250 up 20% is ₱250 + ₱50 = ₱300. Then down 20% of ₱300 is ₱300 − ₱60 = ₱240.
reveal.why_correct: ₱240 is right. Check another way: 250 × 1.2 = 300, and 300 × 0.8 = 240.

why_wrong.n2: ₱250 treats +20% and −20% as cancelling out. The cut is taken from the bigger price, ₱300, so it removes more than the raise added.
why_wrong.n3: ₱288 adds the 20% raise again to ₱240. That is one step too many.
why_wrong.n4: ₱300 is only the price after the raise. It stops before the cut.

source.stem: An Albay library received 360 donated notebooks. It set aside 15% for an outreach class. How many notebooks were set aside?

reveal.terms: Percent means per hundred. Fifteen percent is 15 out of every 100.
reveal.shortcut: Find 10% of 360 = 36. Half of that is 5% = 18. Add 36 + 18 = 54.

why_wrong.o2: 72 notebooks is 20% of 360. It treats the requested 15% as 20%, adding an unsupported five percentage points.
why_wrong.o3: 36 notebooks calculates only 10%, leaving out the additional 5%.
why_wrong.o4: 24 notebooks divides the total by 15 instead of taking 15 hundredths.

source.stem: At a Davao orientation, 18 out of 60 invitees came by bicycle. What percentage of invitees came by bicycle?

reveal.terms: Percentage of a group equals part ÷ whole × 100.
reveal.why_correct: 30% of 60 = 18, so the answer matches the reported bicycle riders.

why_wrong.o1: 3 1/3% reverses part and whole and does not multiply the fraction by 100.
why_wrong.o3: 18% repeats the attendee count as a percent without dividing by the 60 invitees.
why_wrong.o4: 70% describes the people who did not cycle, not the 18 who did.

source.stem: A municipal registrar has encoded 72 documents, which is 25% of the assigned files. How many files were assigned in total?

reveal.terms: Twenty-five percent is one fourth of the whole.
reveal.shortcut: If 72 is one fourth, multiply by 4: 72 × 4 = 288.
reveal.why_correct: One fourth of 288 is 72 files, so 288 is the full assignment.

why_wrong.o1: 18 files takes 25% of the completed portion, not the original total.
why_wrong.o2: 72 files is the already encoded quarter, not the complete assignment.
why_wrong.o4: 96 files divides by the remaining 75% even though 72 is stated as 25%.

source.stem: After a 20% raise, a daily allowance is ₱180. What was the allowance before the raise, in pesos?

reveal.terms: Operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide, percent, fraction.

method_steps.3_method: The new amount is 120% of the old one; divide by 1.2.
method_steps.4_why: The 20% is 20% of the old amount, not of ₱180.
method_steps.7_distractors: 144: Took 20% off 180 (wrong base). 160: Subtracted 20 instead of 20%. 216: Added 20% to 180.
